description: This file defines the VoiceSessionCoordinator class, which manages speech recognition sessions including starting, updating, finalizing, sending, and dismissing voice recognition sessions within an application. It also interfaces with overlay UI components and voice forwarding logic.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for coordinating voice recognition sessions, managing their lifecycle, and interfacing with UI overlays and voice forwarding services.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice recognition session with specified source, text, and optional attributed text, returning a unique token for the session.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the session with partial recognition results, including text and attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the recognition session with the complete text, chime, and optional auto-send delay, updating UI and internal state.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate sending of the recognized text if not empty, dismissing the session otherwise.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session, specifying the reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the input level indicator for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current session token, text, and visibility status.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles overlay dismissal, resetting the session and refreshing runtime state.
